description: He wears an opaque muted burgundy knee-length tunic with narrow cream-and-gold woven borders at the standing neckline, center front and hem. A cream underlayer shows at the collar. A plain sturdy brown leather-looking belt has a rectangular buckle and long hanging end with a small decorative motif. Brown trousers tuck into soft tall brown boots. The cloth is textured and wool-like, the underlayer linen-like; exact fibers are uncertain. His hands are naturally held behind the torso and hidden rather than cropped at an image edge. No headgear, cloak, weapon or armor is visible.
